name.zh: 风格化 Hallucigenia（背棘叶足动物）

description.en: Its distinguishing construction is slender neck, tall paired back spines and much softer curved walking legs; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
description.zh: 以细长颈、成对高背棘与柔软弯曲步足为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

claim_scope: Named-taxon-inspired art using recognizable basic anatomy; not strict scientific, species/specimen, exact dimension, locomotion or coexistence reconstruction.

sources.title: Hallucigenia sparsa — ROM Burgess Shale
sources.supports: Named taxon's fossil occurrence and external morphology in the Description section; reconstruction caveats retained in each asset.

uncertainties.en: Original stylized teaching concept. Palette, nominal dimensions, pose and simplified counts are artistic. No microscopic genus diagnosis, measured specimen, behavior or coexistence reconstruction.
uncertainties.zh: 原创风格化教学概念；配色、标称尺寸、姿态及简化数量为美术选择。不声称微观属级鉴别、标本实测、行为或同域共存复原。

reference_access.observation: Continuous worm-like trunk, long neck, small head, dorsal paired spines and soft ventral limbs. Fine claws, mouth plates and counts simplified. No locomotion claim.
reference_access.limitations: Text/captions read; embedded Sketchfab meshes not downloaded, loaded or incorporated. Historical ledger preserved separately. Reference media rights remain with creators.
